about: Free scene answers from the live walks (docs/ops/live-walks/<date>.md). Each item is one learner answer to the character's question, laid on the captured A1 story payload of tests/prompt_regression with the character taken from the season's world bible. 'verbatim' quotes the report; 'reconstructed' completes a reply the report only quotes in part, keeping every quoted fragment. 'truth' is what the judge is told: the errors really in the answer, whether it refuses, what is off-script.

items.source: live walk 2026-10-20, replies played (verbatim); #254

scene.premise_fr: Lila et toi êtes dans l'appartement d'Odile. Il y a des photos par terre.
scene.objective_native: Tell Lila why you think Odile left.
scene.objective_semantics: Met when the learner gives a reason or a guess, or says they do not know.
scene.opening_line_fr: Pourquoi elle est partie, Odile ?
scene.suggested_response_fr: Je ne sais pas. Elle était fatiguée ?

items.learner_text: Je ne sais pas beaucoup. Odile est parti parce que la restaurant était très difficile, je pense.
